description: On-site cinematography for five separate Guinness World Records ceremonies across Madhya Pradesh and Uttar Pradesh — from record-breaking mass rituals to India's largest classical music ensemble.

records.title: Ayodhya Deepotsav
records.achievement: Largest display of oil lamps (26,17,215 diyas in 2025) and most people performing aarti simultaneously (2,128 in 2025)

records.title: International Gita Mahotsav
records.achievement: 5,000+ Acharyas reciting the Bhagavad Gita's 'Karma Yog' chapter in unison

records.title: Tansen Sangeet Samaroh (100th Edition)
records.achievement: Largest Hindustani classical band — 546 musicians performing together

records.title: "Ek Ped Maa Ke Naam" Plantation Drive
records.achievement: Most trees planted by a team in 24 hours — over 12 lakh saplings

records.title: Largest Damaru Ensemble
records.achievement: 1,390 participants playing the damaru together at Mahakaleshwar Temple

note: Figures independently verified via public Guinness World Records reporting. Certificate numbers and adjudication dates can be added once available.
